cover.report_type: Interim Report: Seven days before a general election

_meta.notes: Unlike the filer's April 2006 report, THIS cover uses the generic (undated) Type-of-Report box labels and no year in the title, and the box checked is 'Seven days before a general election' - the manifest labels it the October report, which is consistent (signed 10/31/06, hand-written clerk receipt 'Received Salt Lake County Clerk' OCT 31 2006). Neither amendment box is checked. Column B is headed 'Year-to-Date Total' on this form vintage. Form arithmetic checks out (23,641.75 + 61,539.00 = 85,180.75; 85,180.75 - 71,484.01 = 13,696.74), and the opening balance matches the closing balance of the filer's September 15 amendment (23,641.75).
